podcast.body: The lead-off single from Bruno Mars's debut album "Doo-Wops & Hooligans," which was subtitled "Amazing" in certain countries to prevent confusion with the older Billy Joel hit. Mars and his co-writers transformed the gentle sentiment of self-acceptance into a soaring anthem, with Mars describing his intent for a direct, heartfelt message akin to Joe Cocker's "You Are So Beautiful" and Eric Clapton's "Wonderful Tonight." It reached atop the Hot 100 in October 2010, marking his first number one hit under his own name. "Just the way you are was the lead-off single to Bruno Mars debut album Do Wops and Hooligans."
